draft.emotion: matter-of-fact and direct, pointing out where something is
notes: Irregular first-person singular in the present (estoy) and irregular stress in the present (estás, está, están). Irregular preterite stem: estuv- (estuve, estuviste, etc.).
Use 'estar' for physical locations (even permanent ones, except for events), temporary states or moods, and ongoing actions. Use 'ser' for identity, origin, time, and inherent qualities.
